title: The Soup Salted the Way the House Likes
youtube_title: The Soup Salted the Way the House Likes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Tala notices that Papa has already taken care of a soup salted after a taste, not before. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Tala does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
